sections.title: Interview Quick Answers
sections.body:
**Q: Difference between dot product and matrix multiplication?**
A: Dot product is for vectors (scalar output). Matrix multiplication is for matrices (matrix output).

**Q: When is a matrix invertible?**
A: When det(A) ≠ 0, full rank, linearly independent columns.

**Q: What's the geometric meaning of dot product?**
A: Measures projection of one vector onto another. High value = similar direction.

**Q: Why standardize features?**
A: To ensure all features contribute equally (same scale). Critical for distance-based algorithms.

**Q: What's the curse of dimensionality?**
A: As dimensions increase, data becomes sparse, distances less meaningful. Solution: dimensionality reduction.
